"""Write the nightly check verdict for Sandwell Forge to results/."""
import os

RESULTS = [("oven_draft", "error"), ("scale_zero", "ok"), ("quench_temp", "error"),
           ("hammer_pressure", "ok"), ("vent_cycle", "ok")]


def main():
    os.makedirs("results", exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join("results", "run-2026-09-14.log"), "w") as handle:
        for name, outcome in RESULTS:
            handle.write("%s %s\n" % (name, outcome))


main()
